sections.h2: Why Rent a Golf Cart in The Villages?

p: The Villages is designed for golf cart travel. With over 100 miles of golf cart paths connecting neighborhoods, shopping centers, restaurants, and recreational facilities, a golf cart is the most convenient way to get around this active adult community.

From the town squares to championship golf courses, from recreation centers to shopping districts, a golf cart rental gives you the freedom to explore all that The Villages has to offer at your own pace.
Spanish Springs, Lake Sumter Landing, and Brownwood
Enjoy live entertainment, shopping, dining, and community events at The Villages' three town squares, all easily accessible by golf cart.
50+ Championship Courses
Access world-class golf courses throughout The Villages. Our golf carts are perfect for getting to and from your favorite courses.
Pools, Fitness, and Activities
Visit recreation centers featuring pools, fitness facilities, pickleball courts, and organized activities throughout The Villages.
Retail and Dining
Shop at Publix, Walmart, and specialty stores, or dine at restaurants throughout The Villages - all accessible via golf cart paths.
Healthcare Access
Conveniently access medical facilities, pharmacies, and healthcare services throughout The Villages using your golf cart rental.
Shows and Events
Attend concerts, shows, and special events at The Sharon Performing Arts Center and other entertainment venues.

sections.h2: How to Rent a Golf Cart

p: Complete our online rental inquiry form with your preferred dates, cart type, and delivery address in The Villages.
Our rental manager will review your request and contact you promptly to confirm availability and provide pricing.
We deliver your golf cart directly to your address in The Villages. All carts are cleaned, inspected, and fully charged.
Explore The Villages at your leisure. We provide pick-up service when your rental period ends.

intro: The Villages is America's premier active adult retirement community, located in Central Florida. Spanning across Sumter, Marion, and Lake counties, The Villages is home to over 130,000 residents and features an extensive network of golf cart paths connecting neighborhoods, shopping centers, recreational facilities, and entertainment venues.

The community is renowned for its active lifestyle, with over 50 championship golf courses, numerous recreation centers, town squares with nightly entertainment, and a wide variety of clubs and activities. Golf carts are not just transportation here - they're an integral part of The Villages lifestyle.
